prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remain consistently too high relative to measured results across most tests.
For home redesign changes, 3 tests agree on positive noise-corrected lift, but no clear effect was seen as none reached significance.
For home wait_info changes, 2 tests agree on positive noise-corrected lift, but no clear effect was seen.
For finish new screen changes, 2 tests agree on negative noise-corrected lift, but no clear effect was seen.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path copy, sign_in hint, and all single-test categories due to disagreeing results or limited tests.
Adoption redesign and sign_in hint are the only kinds of change that proved helpful (won), though evidence remains thin for single-test categories.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Full Bleed Gallery View: Redesign the pet selection screen with an immersive full-bleed gallery layout highlighting pet visual details. (why: Adoption has a 66.2% conversion rate with high decision time (mean 1017s); previous adoption redesigns proved successful.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Quiz Stage: Insert a short personality quiz screen before pet selection to recommend matching companion options. (why: Users take a long time choosing pets (median 89s / mean 1017s). A guided quiz reduces choice paralysis and boosts adoption conversion.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Multi-Device Sync Guarantee: Display an explicit sync hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that logging in protects their pet data across restarts. (why: The top support complaint (8 emails) is pets disappearing or resetting after signing in again; sign_in hints have proven helpful in testing.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Preparation Progress Checklist: Show an animated progress indicator and time estimate while the app prepares the pet desktop environment. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s); clear progress feedback reduces user fatigue and app abandonment during loading.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Centered Grid Layout: Rebuild the path selection screen using a balanced centered layout to present onboarding paths clearly. (why: Choose path has a high mean duration of 514s (median 8s), indicating high dropoff for indecisive users.)
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Quickstart Onboarding Flow: Add a dedicated quickstart tutorial screen at the end of onboarding illustrating key desktop interactions. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to interact with or control the pet post-onboarding (3 controls emails, 4 bug/behavior emails).)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Background Rendering Notification: Add a desktop readiness notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet setup finishes. (why: Home wait time averages 2336s (median 201s). Enabling notifications prevents users from missing when their pet is ready.)
7: [finish, layout] Finish Screen Spotlight Welcome View: Switch the final completion view layout to spotlight mode to emphasize the primary launch action. (why: Finish stage dropoff is high with only 64.8% completion and median time of 395s.)
8: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Rendering Assurance Hint: Include an explanatory quality hint on the photo upload step outlining how uploaded photos are processed into pet models. (why: Support logged 3 issues regarding custom pet creation failing or rendering incorrectly.)
9: [choose_path, copy] Path Choice Clarity Headline: Update headline and subtext on path selection to contrast instant path versus custom photo path clearly. (why: Path choice mean duration is high (514s), showing confusion over which path to choose.)
